result.reason: The duty is real. SVGTA Tourism Approved licences are annual. The 2021 cycle ran Dec 2020 to Oct 2021, and an older notice set a 1 Nov renewal deadline. They need an annual inspection and a fee. The Climate Resilience Levy has been in force since 2018 at US$3 per room per night (about EC$8) for the first 30 nights. I found no software, portal or SVG-specific service doing this, but I ran only two searches. I could not find the IRD return form, the filing frequency or the penalty, and I did not confirm that the licence renewal has no online portal. The market is small, about 150 or more properties, and one to two annual events are a thin base for a product. Willingness to pay is low and the market is tiny.

Duties are real per vendor pages: annual tax return to IRD, registers updates, and the SVG economic substance regime (International Cooperation (Economic Substance) Act 2020). The KPMG repeal note concerns Barbados, not SVG, and I found no SVG repeal. I could not confirm exact deadlines or penalties from primary law. Expanship and Healy already sell this as a done-for-you service. I found no agent-facing software and no count of licensed registered agents (Registered Agent Trustee (Licensing) Act). The buyer pool looks tiny, probably a few dozen agents, and the FSA portal is only a registry search. Weak market and no primary-source confirmation.

Duty is real: Proceeds of Crime Act 2013 s.155(1) requires NRSPs (real estate agents, car dealers, jewellers, casinos, lawyers, notaries, accountants) to register with the FIU. NRSP Regulations 2022 (S.R.&O. 5 of 2022) and the AML/TF Code 2017 add due diligence, record-keeping and reporting. I found no periodic return form, filing frequency or penalty figures, so a recurring workflow is unproven. No local software or free state tool was found, but only 2 searches were run. The market is tiny (probably a few hundred firms, no register count found), the FIU is not an accessible buyer, and generic AML tools exist. Low willingness to pay; score 3.
